name: OpenSwissData
description: Swiss federal reference data for AI agents: Swiss customs tariff lines (TARES, 8-digit tariff numbers) with MFN duty and preferential regimes, the FINMA register of supervised institutions and the FINMA warnings list, and NOGA 2008/2025, NACE 2.0/2.1 and ISIC 4 correspondences. Three tools work without a key or sign-up (100 calls per hour per IP address); five more need an existing access grant, and new subscriptions are closed. Unofficial copy of public sources; full datasets are sold as signed files.

tools.name: tariff_lookup
tools.description: Swiss customs tariff line for an 8-digit tariff number (MFN duty, preferential regimes, restrictions, relief codes), or the Swiss lines under a 2- to 7-digit HS prefix (no key)

tools.name: kyc_check
tools.description: Search the FINMA register and the FINMA warnings list by name, closest matches first, with total counts (no key)

tools.name: cross_walk
tools.description: Map an activity code between NOGA 2008/2025, NACE 2.0/2.1 and ISIC 4, with the relation type and its source (no key)

tools.name: tariff_semantic_search
tools.description: Find 8-digit TARES lines from a description in French, German, Italian or English, using each line's official hierarchy (existing access grant required)

tools.name: tariff_changelog
tools.description: MFN duty history of an 8-digit tariff number across archived releases (existing access grant required)

tools.name: classify_text
tools.description: Suggest NOGA 2025 subclasses for an activity description in French, German, Italian or English (existing access grant required)

tools.name: finma_search
tools.description: FINMA register search tolerant of accents, legal forms and typos, each match labelled with its type (existing access grant required)

tools.name: entity_history
tools.description: Change history of a FINMA-supervised entity by Swiss UID (existing access grant required)
